# `languages/ci/nix:V174`: a site with holes loads through
# `builtins.replaceStrings [ "__NAME__" ... ] [ "<hole>" ... ] (<V53 load>)`,
# and the load spans the WHOLE call -- `inline` replaces all of it, and
# `xnl graph` follows its path. Only the shape `rewrite_bound` writes is
# the whole call: `__NAME__` patterns, as many holes, each a `${...}` with at
# most a path tail. Any other `replaceStrings` around a V53 load is the
# author's own, and the load is the V53 call inside it. Whitespace is
# shown collapsed.
./a/a-script.sh | shell | builtins.replaceStrings [ "__HELLO_BIN__" "__DIR__" ] [ "${pkgs.hello}/bin/hello" "${cfg.dir}" ] (builtins.readFile ./a/a-script.sh)
./a/b-script.sh | shell | builtins.replaceStrings [ "__X__" ] [ "${cfg.x}" ] ( nix-shebang.lib.readWithoutStrict ./a/b-script.sh )
./a/hook.sh | shell | builtins.replaceStrings [ "__X__" ] [ "${cfg.x}" ] (builtins.readFile ./a/hook.sh)
./a/other.sh | shell | builtins.readFile ./a/other.sh
./a/uneven.sh | shell | builtins.readFile ./a/uneven.sh
./a/escaped.sh | shell | builtins.readFile ./a/escaped.sh
